B0: Immutable baseline algorithm and its existing version remain unchanged.
activation_condition: Only the selected policy version, and every configured non-relevance lane has exactly zero weight. Relevance is strictly positive under existing valid-config rules. Empty non-relevance set satisfies this condition.
precedence: For this condition, preserve the complete immutable B0 eligible-candidate order before packing. This explicitly overrides the ordinary trust/updated/key final-tie rule for binary64 collisions between distinct baseline ranks.
numeric_scores: Keep the existing lane order, dense ranks, binary64 weight/(60+dense_rank) terms and fusion-score bits, including underflow-to-zero. No epsilon, clamp, minimum positive weight, decimal substitution or implicit coefficient normalization. Baseline equivalence is ordered references and packing/cost, not equality of differently defined numeric scores.
validation: Perform all existing input, registry, snapshot, scope, revision, state and feature availability/lineage checks before selecting the order. Zero auxiliary weight does not waive state/feature validation or imply absent data is zero.
packing: Use the same eligible candidates in baseline order and unchanged context budget/final_k/PackContext rules; preserve original lane ordinals before eligibility filtering.
other_weights: If any configured auxiliary weight is positive, retain the unchanged fixed binary64 score and ordinary final-tie ordering. Tiny positive auxiliary values do not activate this exception.
historical_versions: Previously recorded configurations retain their original arithmetic and ordering semantics. The new selected registry explicitly names the new version for the six non-B0 policies; old valid-registry counterexample remains reproducible as historical evidence, not the selected-method acceptance target.
registry_binding: Preserve all numeric parameters, role lists, inheritance/ablation semantics and seven policy IDs. Update only the six policy-version labels and consequent ranker/config/graph/registry association hashes. Never alter the fixed DYN or v1 DTOs/contracts.
evidence_requirement: Replay the original registered subnormal counterexample against the new selected version, plus exact baseline ties, normal/subnormal relevance, zero and smallest-positive auxiliary weights, sparse/empty/ineligible lanes, all required state/feature failures and complete native CLI/compare flow. Historical old-version divergence remains explicit evidence, not a skipped test.
